module.purpose: Provides the shared client-side page shell for the web application, composing providers, SEO metadata, security nonce handling, fonts, licensing gates, layouts, status signaling, and analytics around each page.
module.summary: This client component is the application-wide wrapper used by Next.js pages. It derives HTTP-like page status from the route, normalizes nonces differently on server and client to avoid hydration issues, selects page-defined layouts, conditionally enforces licensing, configures canonical SEO URLs, injects font variables and page status into the document, and mounts global providers, icon sprites, and tag management.
module.businessContext: This supports the Cal.com web application shell and its page rendering, SEO, security, branding, licensing, and analytics concerns. Failure can produce broken page composition, hydration warnings, incorrect metadata, missing fonts, or bypassed licensing UI.
classes: CalPageWrapper (~L21-24): Callable page wrapper contract with optional page-level layout support
functions: PageWrapper (~L35-109): Composes providers, metadata, scripts, fonts, licensing, layouts, and analytics
systemCapabilities: Inject global fonts and page status

io: Renders document metadata, a page-status script, global styles, icon sprites, and analytics components.

Page components may expose requiresLicense and getLayout properties expected by the wrapper.

concurrencyModel.notes: Rendering is synchronous and derives output solely from props, route state, configuration, and client/server availability.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The wrapper renders a designated Next.js error route.
moduleContractTests.then: window.CalComPageStatus equals the corresponding route status string
moduleContractTests.rationale: Error routes must expose their status for downstream page handling.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The wrapper renders on the server with a nonce in page props.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Server-rendered security attributes must remain available to provider and script consumers.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The wrapper hydrates on the client after a server nonce was present.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Client hydration must avoid nonce mismatches and browser nonce removal warnings.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The page component provides a custom layout function.
moduleContractTests.then: The rendered page is passed through Component.getLayout
moduleContractTests.rationale: Page-level layouts must control page composition when supplied.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The page component requires a license.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Licensed pages must not bypass the license gate.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The application renders with either the Cal.com or self-hosted deployment configuration.
moduleContractTests.then: DefaultSeo receives buildCanonical({ path, origin: "https://cal.com" }) when IS_CALCOM is truthy and buildCanonical({ path, origin: WEBAPP_URL }) otherwise
moduleContractTests.rationale: Canonical URLs must identify the correct deployment origin.
